reason: The cited evidence (E1) only mentions that HfMoTaTiZr was fabricated and analyzed as part of a subtraction study, but provides no data on its density, phase structure, or mechanical properties, nor any comparison with an Nb-substituted variant. Therefore, none of the key premises about density reduction, phase stability, or strength retention are supported by the cited passage.
premises: Replacing Hf with Nb reduces density because Nb is lighter.
NbMoTaTiZr will form a single-phase solid solution like HfMoTaTiZr.
Solid solution strengthening will be maintained after substitution.
Phase stability will be retained at room temperature and ~1000 °C.
Mechanical strength will be retained or closely matched.
